provenance: Original analytic mesh authored for EndoForge in Blender. Teacher-provided assets are references, not copied geometry.

hepatic_bed.construction: Locally refined continuous top of the same closed hepatic support

phase6_liver_revision.scope: Remote rigid liver shape only; operative bed and complete gallbladder FEM unchanged

phase6_interaction.scope: Engineering interaction rig, not clinical trocar placement guidance.

posterior_field.basis: C2 cubic r^3 radial field plus linear polynomial; exact anchors and regularized non-anchor controls.
posterior_field.source: Accepted Phase 6 operative height samples; macro rim/equator and bad lateral shoulder are not copied into the new collider.
posterior_field.scope: Original engineering reconstruction. Full physical and visual requalification required; no clinical anatomical validation.

phase7_liver_revision.ready_recipe: Original Phase 6 recipe retained; clearance guard unchanged.
